summary: Hacker News story-list sync fetches /item/<id>.json for each listed ID and stores the full body.
reason: Firebase list endpoints return bare IDs, so synced rows had no title, score or comment count for the analytics commands (issue #800). Large integer IDs decoded to float64 also printed in exponent form, which would mis-key hydrated rows.
validated_outcome: A live sync of the show and job lists stored 171 of 171 rows with titles and plain integer IDs; go build, go vet and go test -race pass.
